V.01 draftBuilt from Oracle documentation and official sources. Not yet reviewed by a Vanderbilt SME; confirm the open items before release.

Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: Exact label of the rehire field on Vanderbilt's Terminate Employment page (Recommended for rehire or Eligible for rehire) and its values (Yes, No, Not specified); Who can approve rehiring someone marked No, and how Not specified is treated; Where recruiters see the rehire recommendation in Oracle Recruiting; Whether rehires through a requisition need any extra step before conversion.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

A rehire is someone who worked here before and is coming back. Oracle already has their person record, so the hire adds a new work relationship to that record instead of creating a new person.

Whether they can come back is decided by the rehire recommendation recorded when they were terminated. Recruiters review it, and you should know what it says before you move forward.

Use this whenA candidate you want to hire used to work at Vanderbilt, or you are terminating someone and need to set the rehire field.

2 · Walk through

How rehires work.

Check off each item as you read.

Rehire recommendation at a glance
Value on terminationWhat it means for a rehire
YesEligible; recruiter proceeds through the normal process.
NoNot eligible without review; talk to the recruiter and your PCB consultant.
Not specifiedTreat as a flag; ask before moving forward.

Watch-outs

  • The rehire field is only as good as the termination entry. Set it carefully when you terminate someone; recruiters rely on it later.
  • Search inactive records before hiring a familiar name. A duplicate person record is hard to undo.
  • Open item: confirm with your engagement consultant (EC) who can approve rehiring someone marked No, and how Not specified is handled.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Rehire a Worker (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Hiring

Rehires and eligibility for rehire

Use when: A candidate you want to hire used to work at Vanderbilt, or you are terminating someone and need to set the rehire field. · System: Oracle Recruiting

  1. Know that the rehire field is set at termination.
    • Misconduct: No or Not specified, per your PCB consultant.
  2. Check the former employee's record before you commit.
  3. Let the recruiter review eligible for rehire.
  4. Never create a second person record.
  5. Convert the pending worker as you would any hire.
  6. Review costing on the new assignment.
